title: chat.php request body
description: Form-encoded POST body accepted by public/chat.php. The patient id and current encounter are taken from the OpenEMR session only; a pid in the body is not part of the contract and is ignored. The session cookie must belong to an authenticated user with patients/med and encounters/notes ACL (rate included: only a user who could see the briefing can rate it).

csrf_token_form.description: OpenEMR CSRF token for the session, as embedded in the panel markup. Missing or wrong token: 403.

action.description: brief: assemble facts and return the verified briefing (cached by facts hash, prompt version and model). ask: answer a follow-up question about the same fact set. rate: record the physician's thumbs up or down (and optional comment) on the AI summary a briefing showed.

question.description: ask only. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character; trimmed and truncated to 500 characters server-side.

facts_hash.description: ask only. The facts_hash from the briefing the thread started on. If the chart has changed since, the response is chat.chart-changed.response and no answer is produced.

transcript.description: ask only. JSON-encoded array of {role: user|assistant, text, turn_token?} turns held by the browser; the server keeps the last 10, truncates each text to 1000 characters, and ignores malformed input. An assistant turn counts only with the turn_token its answer carried: the server replaces its text with the sealed server text, and drops assistant turns whose token is missing, altered, or minted for another patient or chart version.

rating.description: rate only. The physician's rating of the AI summary.

comment.description: rate only, optional. Free text, trimmed server-side; empty means no comment. Stored in copilot_briefing_rating only: it may name the patient, so it never reaches a log line, the audit comment or the trace.

cache_key.description: rate only. narration.cache_key from the briefing whose summary is rated: the cached narration shown. It must belong to the session patient's cached briefings, or the rating is refused (409).

briefing_correlation_id.description: rate only. correlation_id of the briefing response that showed the summary; the physician_rating score attaches to that trace.

oneOf.description: ask needs the question and the facts_hash the thread started on.
rate needs the rating and the briefing it is about.
